method.pricing: Price, 24h change, market cap, and FDV are read from the returned Solana pool with the greatest reported USD liquidity in which each canonical mint is the base token.
method.liquidity: Liquidity and 24h volume are summed across distinct Solana pair addresses in which each canonical mint is the base token. Duplicate pair records are counted once.
method.valuation: Market cap is recorded only when DexScreener reports marketCap. FDV is stored separately and is never used as a market-cap substitute.
method.limitations: DexScreener is an independent index. A snapshot can be delayed, incomplete, or wrong, and does not represent a recommendation.
